command: Edit this picture. It is a cut-paper character on cream paper; the flat magenta areas are where his right arm (its sleeve and round hand) was cut away to make a cut-out puppet. He is seen in profile, facing the viewer's right, and his other arm does not show. Repaint ONLY the magenta areas, as what lies underneath his arm: the side of his body from the armpit down to the robe, painted in exactly the same style, colours and soft shading as his body round the arm (his back's outline and the walnut-brown edge band of the olive mantle behind it, the olive mantle over his side, its front panel and the walnut strap before it, the belt round his waist, the linen tunic below). No seed bag shows on this side: paint none. Each side of his body runs straight down from the outer end of his shoulder to the outer edge of his robe below, so his body under the arms is as wide as his shoulders and his robe, and the linen tunic and olive mantle fill everything inside that line with the same soft shade and fine paper grain the sheet paints beside each arm. Keep the soft shade each arm casts on his body beside it exactly as it is, and carry that same shade on under where the arm was. Paint the linen tunic and olive mantle of his body with the same fine paper grain the sheet shows on them beside the arms: a fine, even speckle through every flat area of colour, never smooth flat colour. There is no arm now: no sleeve, no hand, nothing magenta left. Where the magenta lay outside his body, it becomes the plain cream paper. Keep every other pixel exactly as it is: the same head, headcloth and its tail, face, beard, tunic, mantle, walnut strap, belt, feet, size, position and framing.
